en: So you dug your way down here. I'm Clay, boss of these mines and Leader of this Gym. I don't go easy on anybody!
Let's see if your team's got the grit to strike it rich against mine!
Well, I'll be. You struck a seam I never saw comin'. Here, you earned it fair and square.
{player} received the Quake Badge from Clay!
Your fifth Badge, is it? Then take this along with it. A move that shakes the ground and slows down whoever it hits.
Now get on up out of my mine. I've got work to do, and so have you!
Hard work never lies, kid. Not to you, and not to your Pokémon.
